status_note: Not tested by us. Everything here is copied from the vendor's pages on the dates given; run `python -m rak.models control deepseek` before relying on it.

claude_code.why: min: the kit's hooks need onFailure: block (2.1.295+). pin: the version the kit was last developed against (2026-11-01); not tested with this endpoint by us.

limits.text: model names must start with claude or be a DeepSeek name: claude-opus* maps to deepseek-v4-pro, claude-sonnet* and claude-haiku* to deepseek-flash, other names return 400
tool_choice any is treated as auto (does not force a tool call); tool_choice tool returns 400 in thinking mode; disable_parallel_tool_use is ignored
tool_result is_error, cache_control and mcp_servers are ignored; document, search_result, mcp_tool_use and mcp_tool_result are not supported
the anthropic-beta header is ignored for /messages; thinking budget_tokens is ignored; max_tokens is not a strict limit for some Claude Code thinking requests
deepseek-flash returns 400 on images in assistant messages; deepseek-v4-pro replaces images with [Unsupported Image]
subagents, WebSearch and WebFetch broke against DeepSeek in Claude Code issue #65863
Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models; treat every Claude Code upgrade as untested until the positive control passes

data_policy.where: "store your Personal Data in People's Republic of China"
data_policy.training: may be used "to train and improve"; opt-out by email
data_policy.retention: "as long as you have an account"
